title: Home Water Efficiency Challenge
tagline: Simple actions to reduce water use at home and beyond.
description: This challenge focuses on building simple habits that help reduce daily household water use. Many homes unknowingly waste water through leaks, long showers, or unnecessary tap use. Over the next seven days, you’ll practice mindful water- saving actions that are easy to adopt and highly effective in protecting freshwater resources.The goal is to help you become more conscious of your usage and identify areas for improvement.

dailyToDo.text: Turn off the tap while brushing or shaving.
Wash dishes using a bowl instead of running tap water.

uniqueToDo.text: Check faucets for small leaks or drips.
Record one water-saving action you completed.

title: Energy Efficiency Challenge
tagline: Simple actions to reduce water use at home and beyond.
description: This challenge focuses on building simple habits that help reduce daily household water use. Many homes unknowingly waste water through leaks, long showers, or unnecessary tap use. Over the next seven days, you’ll practice mindful water- saving actions that are easy to adopt and highly effective in protecting freshwater resources.The goal is to help you become more conscious of your usage and identify areas for improvement.

dailyToDo.text: Turn off lights when leaving a room.
Use natural light instead of lamps when possible.
Set your thermostat 1–2 degrees lower or higher depending on season.

uniqueToDo.text: Conduct an energy audit of your home appliances.
Switch one light bulb to an energy-efficient LED.
Identify and replace a high-energy consuming appliance if possible.

Over the next seven days, you’ll practice mindful water- saving actions that are easy to adopt and highly effective in protecting freshwater resources.The goal is to help you become more conscious of your usage and identify areas for improvement.

dailyToDo.text: Walk or bike for short trips instead of using a car.
Carpool or share rides with family or colleagues.

uniqueToDo.text: Plan your week to reduce unnecessary trips.
Check tire pressure and maintain your vehicle for efficiency.
Try one completely car-free day this week.

dailyToDo.text: Bring a reusable water bottle or cup.

uniqueToDo.text: Plan a meat-free meal once this week.

Set a personal sustainability goal for the week.
